description: This file contains the implementation of the AccountingRuleWritePlatformService interface, specifically the class AccountingRuleWritePlatformServiceJpaRepositoryImpl. It provides methods for creating, updating, and deleting accounting rules, handling data integrity issues, and managing associated tags and accounts within the accounting module of the application.

classes.name: AccountingRuleWritePlatformServiceJpaRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the AccountingRuleWritePlatformService interface, managing creation, update, and deletion of accounting rules with embedded validation and integrity handling.

methods.name: handleAccountingRuleIntegrityIssues
methods.description: Handles data integrity exceptions specific to accounting rules, throwing custom exceptions based on error messages.

methods.name: createAccountingRule
methods.description: Creates a new accounting rule after validation, linking accounts or tags and handling potential data integrity issues.

methods.name: assembleAccountingRuleAndTags
methods.description: Prepares an AccountingRule object based on input parameters, accounts, and tags.

methods.name: updateAccountingRule
methods.description: Updates an existing accounting rule, modifying accounts, tags, and related metadata with validation.

methods.name: determineCreditTagToAddAndRemoveOldTags
methods.description: Determines which tags need to be added or removed during an update based on incoming data.

methods.name: retrieveExistingTagIds
methods.description: Extracts existing tag IDs from a set of AccountingTagRule objects.

methods.name: deleteAccountingRule
methods.description: Deletes an existing accounting rule identified by its ID.

methods.name: saveDebitOrCreditTags
methods.description: Creates and adds new tag rules based on provided tag IDs and transaction type.
